macyepay.place: Kigali, Rwanda · abacuruzi mu gihugu hose
macyepay.blurb: Kwishyura mu byiciro ku bucuruzi bwo mu Rwanda, bishingiye ku masezerano yemejwe na noteri, kwishyuza byikora no guhuzwa n'ikigo cy'inguzanyo.
macyepay.summary: MacyePay ifasha abacuruzi n'abatanga inguzanyo kugurisha mu byiciro batabuze amafaranga yabo. Buri gahunda ni amasezerano yemewe n'amategeko, agenzurwa na noteri; kwibutsa, ibihano no gukurikirana bikorwa byikora; kandi amateka yo kwishyura yubaka amanota y'icyizere kuri buri mukiriya. Twayishushanyije, tuyubaka kandi ni twe tuyikoresha: urubuga rw'abacuruzi, porogaramu ya telefoni n'inzira ya noteri ibihuza.

result.label: Igipimo cyo kwishyuza ku masezerano akora

meta.scope: Igishushanyo cy'igicuruzwa · Urubuga rw'abacuruzi · Porogaramu y'abakiriya · Inzira ya noteri · Backend n'ihuzwa

delivered: Urubuga rw'abacuruzi: urutonde rw'ibicuruzwa, kugenzura abakiriya, gukora amasezerano, gukurikirana kwishyura, imibare na raporo.
Porogaramu y'abakiriya: ingengabihe isobanutse, uburyo bwinshi bwo kwishyura, kwibutswa, amanota y'icyizere no kubona inyandiko.
Inzira ya noteri: kugenzura mu buryo bw'ikoranabuhanga, gusinya mu mutekano, gucunga inyandiko n'amateka yose y'ibyakozwe.
Kwishyuza byikora: kwibutsa, kubara ibihano, gukurikirana no gutanga amakuru ku kigo cy'inguzanyo.

screens.caption: Ikibaho cy'umucuruzi: amafaranga yinjiye, igipimo cyo kwishyuza n'igihe cya gahunda
Incamake y'amasezerano: ingengabihe, imikono n'aho noteri igeze
Urutonde rwo kwemeza gahunda nshya zo kwishyura mu byiciro
Kwishyuza: kwibutsa, ibihano n'intambwe zo gukurikirana

phone.title: Porogaramu y'ikofi y'ubucuruzi
phone.text: Amafaranga yishyuwe ajya mu ikofi y'ubucuruzi. Nyirayo areba amafaranga ahari n'amakuru y'ikarita, agasaba kubikuza kuri mobile money, maze mugenzi we ufite uburenganzira akabyemeza.

screens.caption: Ikofi: amafaranga ahari, amakuru y'ikarita n'ibikuzwa biheruka
Kubikuza: amafaranga, kwemeza n'aho kwemezwa bigeze

journey.title: Gukora
journey.text: Umucuruzi ahitamo igicuruzwa, akagenzura umukiriya, agashyiraho ingengabihe y'icyumweru, ibyumweru bibiri cyangwa ukwezi.

journey.title: Gusinya no kwemeza
journey.text: Impande zombi zisinya kuri murandasi; noteri wemewe agenzura amasezerano, agahita yubahirizwa n'amategeko.

journey.title: Kwishyura
journey.text: Umukiriya yishyura na mobile money cyangwa ikarita; yibutswa mbere ya buri tariki.

journey.title: Kwishyuza
journey.text: Gutinda bitera ibihano no gukurikirana byikora; amateka agaburira amanota y'icyizere.

engineering.title: Imbuga eshatu, API imwe
engineering.text: Abacuruzi, abakiriya na noteri basangiye backend imwe, ifite uburenganzira bushingiye ku nshingano n'imiterere imwe y'amasezerano.

engineering.title: Imikono iri muri PDF
engineering.text: Imikono y'umukiriya n'iy'umucuruzi ishyirwa muri PDF y'amasezerano kuri seriveri, bityo inyandiko yemejwe na noteri iba ifite yombi.

engineering.title: Guhuza ubwishyu
engineering.text: Ubutumwa bw'abatanga serivisi bushobora kugera nyuma y'uko umukoresha agarutse; ubwishyu burabazwa bugahuzwa kugira ngo ubutumwa bwo gutsinda butaba ibinyoma.

engineering.title: Telefoni mbere
engineering.text: Porogaramu y'abakiriya yubatswe na Flutter kuri Android na iOS, isangiye igishushanyo n'urubuga.

retail-rollout.title: Gushyiraho imashini zishyuza
retail-rollout.blurb: Imashini zishyuza, umuyoboro wa interineti n'ubufasha aho bakorera ku mucuruzi ufite amashami menshi.
retail-rollout.summary: Inkuru y'urugero yerekana uko umushinga w'ibikoresho werekanwa hano: kugura, kugeza, gushyiraho no kwita ku mashini zishyuza n'umuyoboro mu mashami yose. Isimbura umushinga nyawo kugeza usohowe muri Studio.
delivered: Kugura: imashini, printeri na scanner bivuye ku bacuruzi bemewe, bifite garanti.
Gushyiraho: insinga, Wi-Fi n'imashini itunganyijwe kuri buri kontwari, ishami ku rindi.
Ubufasha: ikigo cy'ubufasha n'ibikoresho by'inyongera kugira ngo imashini yapfuye isimburwe uwo munsi.

journey.title: Kugenzura
journey.text: Buri shami rirasurwa: kontwari, amashanyarazi, umuyoboro n'abakozi.

journey.title: Kugeza
journey.text: Ibikoresho bigera bitunganyijwe, bigashyirwaho kandi bigageragezwa aho.

journey.title: Gufasha
journey.text: Ibibazo byose bijya ku kigo kimwe cy'ubufasha; ibikoresho by'inyongera bituma buri kontwari ikora.

engineering.title: Bitunganywa mbere yo kugezwa
engineering.text: Imashini zitegurwa kandi zandikwa hagati, bityo ishami ritangira gukora mu masaha make.

engineering.title: Umuyoboro ugenzurwa
engineering.text: Router n'ibikoresho bya Wi-Fi by'amashami bikurikiranwa ku kibaho kimwe.
